shared_elements: quadruped animal shown in profile, low relief
relief carving on the broad face of a vertical, T-headed slab
animal placed on the shaft just below the wide upper head
justification: Both surfaces carry a schematic quadruped in strict profile carved in shallow relief on the shaft of a broad T-headed slab, immediately under the projecting head — a fairly specific shared scheme. The biggest difference is density and variety of content: A is crowded with multiple registers (a row of arched/animal forms along the head, a woven or netted band, several animals, a small humanoid figure and long-necked birds), while B shows a single isolated animal on an otherwise blank field.
